changelog:
- Initial release of the audio-recognition skill for speech-to-text tasks.
- Supports accurate transcription of audio to text with speaker diarization.
- Includes noise reduction, audio normalization, and multi-language recognition.
- Features robust post-processing: punctuation, error correction, and optional timestamps.
- Suitable for meeting transcriptions, subtitle generation, voice command recognition, and content extraction.
summary: 音频语音识别服务(Speech-to-Text)。当用户上传音频文件，需要将语音内容转换为文字，或需要识别音频中的特定信息（如关键词、歌曲名）时触发。 适用于：(1) 会议录音转写 (2) 音频内容提取 (3) 语音指令识别 (4) 音视频字幕生成
